identity.title: Forecasting the Contribution of Polarized Extragalactic Radio Sources in CMB Observations

paper_type_evidence.quote: We combine the latest datasets obtained with different surveys to study the frequency dependence of polarized emission coming from Extragalactic Radio Sources (ERS).
32 of them have been also followed up at 95 GHz onto 3 circular regions ($10 ^{\circ}$ of diameter) at ecliptic latitude $<-75 ^{\circ}$ with the Atacama Large Millimeter Array (ALMA)
